## Outcome
The original KP-3.51 question remains **unsolved**. The package records the gap between reducible-only representation sets and the nondegeneracy or local Floer information required by the known instanton L-space argument.

## Narrow mathematical source check
The exact printed Definition 5.3 and torus-knot clause of Corollary 5.4 in arXiv:2608.20551v1 are tested using slope-6 surgery on the trefoil. The distinction between unsquared and squared character systems matters. This is a version-specific mathematical diagnostic, not a broader criticism of the paper or its authors. The trefoil filling is itself a known instanton L-space and is not a counterexample to KP-3.51.

## Review
The frozen mathematical artifact passed separate adversarial review without mandatory corrections. All 114 submitted and 100 independent controls passed, including independent cohomology checks of all six squared rank-one systems. The abstract quartic local model is not asserted to be realized by Chern-Simons theory or by a three-manifold.

One substantive attempt used. Actual author and reviewer model: gpt-6-astra, xhigh. No novelty, priority, or full solution is claimed.

Queue disposition: **unsolved, 1/5**. The campaign's single queue writer will add the row update. This commit changes only this problem's attempt folder.

No merge or release is requested.
